attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as the authoritative-plus-forwarding DNS resolver for the 10.100.10.0/24 private network: it answers inventory.internal with node2's address (10.100.10.11) via a local authoritative-domain record, and forwards all other queries to upstream resolvers (1.1.1.1, 9.9.9.9). Configured node2 and node3 (Ubuntu 24.04) to use node1 (10.100.10.10) as their DNS server via a persistent systemd-networkd drop-in (DNS= override, UseDNS=no to stop DHCP-supplied DNS from overriding it). Verified resolution end-to-end from both nodes before and after a full sequential restart of all three nodes, confirming persistence.
